If secA + tanA = 5/2, what is the value of (secA - tanA)?
e: অভেদ sec²A - tan²A = 1 অর্থাৎ (secA + tanA)(secA - tanA) = 1। তাই secA - tanA = 1/(secA + tanA) = 1 ÷ (5/2) = 2/5।
